terms.definition: A named step sequence a task runs through, resolved from a base archetype plus overrides. Declares each step's role and whether it gates for approval.
One unit of the pipeline — analyze, design, implement, review, qa — dispatched to a single specialist and producing exactly one output.json.
The deterministic driver in cli/src/supervisor.ts. Decides which step runs next, validates its output, and transitions task state. Never an LLM decision (ADR-0004).
The agent dispatched for one step, identified by the step's role and given a composed skill list.
output.json, the sole canonical artifact a step persists (ADR-0005). Schema-validated at write time.
A specialist's report that it cannot proceed — needs-splitting, contradictory-input, criterion-unsatisfiable. Parks the task without consuming the reopen budget.
Reopening a step because its output was malformed. Carries repairErrors and is budgeted by maxReopenCount.
Reopening a step because a later step was rejected. Carries reworkFrom — the rejected step, the comment, and its output — and is not a validation failure.
The reopen budget is spent. Terminal without human intervention.
The ordered skill list an agent loads: base step skill, then language, custom, and global layers.
A delivery milestone with success criteria, grouping tasks. Verified criterion by criterion when it closes.
Phase Learning Record — the prose retrospective written for people, deliberately not JSON.
